Builds the backtest topology and runs replay, exec, snapshot, and support tiles.

# Purpose
This file defines the `backtest` command for `fdctl`. It builds a reduced Firedancer topology that replays shreds and drives replay execution in a single process. The topology includes the `backt` tile, the `replay` tile, one or more `exec` tiles, and optional snapshot loader tiles. It also creates the links that connect replay input, replay notifications, tower-style slot completion messages, execution output, and replay-to-exec communication. The code selects between snapshot-based startup and genesis-based startup, and it sets tile options such as `allow_shutdown` and replay feature flags.

The file also sets up the shared objects used by the tiles, such as `store`, `banks`, `bh_cmp`, `txncache`, and per-exec `exec_spad` objects. It configures command arguments, permission checks, and command execution. In `backtest_cmd_fn`, it initializes workspaces and stacks, joins and fills the topology, and then runs the topology with `fd_topo_run_single_process`. If watch mode is enabled, it redirects `stderr` to a pipe and starts `watch_cmd_fn`; if not, it pauses after the topology starts. The file exports the `fd_action_backtest` action record, which registers the command name, argument handler, permission handler, topology builder, and run function.
